review.headline: Easy 9 km completed at 5:42/km, inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy band with HR steady at 138 bpm.
observations: Distance 8.99 km against a 9.0 km plan, essentially on target.
Every km split was 5:42/km (342 s), showing very even, controlled pacing.
Average HR 138 bpm with max 141 bpm, consistent with relaxed conversational effort.
Cadence 174 spm and zero elevation gain, a clean and easy run.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so subjective effort is unknown.
Weekly volume is far behind plan (16.99 km actual vs 42 km planned), and CTL has fallen from 43 to 26.7 over the last week.
